_sources: Dael, N., Mortillaro, M., & Scherer, K. R. (2012). The Body Action and Posture coding system (BAP): Development and reliability. Journal of Nonverbal Behavior, 36, 97-121. doi:10.1007/s10919-012-0130-0.

Unit names are the behavior variables of the BAP scheme as listed in the public supplementary material 'Appendix A: Complete List of Behavioral Variables of the BAP Coding Scheme' (BAP variables and reliability.pdf), downloaded from https://www.unige.ch/cisa/gemep/bap-coding on 2026-10-05.

Posture-unit codes (HVD-PU, SE-PU, CD-PU, LSU, A_hold_A_front, LH_pocket, ...) and the functional categories (Emblem, Illustrator, Manipulator, Beat, Deictic) are the track names in the public BAP manual (BAP Manual.zip, same page). The BAP XML scheme itself is password-gated and restricted from redistribution; it was not accessed and nothing from it is reproduced here.

Action units have no short code in the public material (the manual defines them through Head-AU/Trunk-AU/arm AU form attributes), so their code here is 'BAP:' + the official variable name. The paper PDF (doc.rero.ch) returned HTTP 410 and Springer is paywalled; the paper text was not read. The renderable descriptions and closeness limits are this project's own wording.
_note: maxCloseness: the unit is on offer only when the shot is at most this close (0 wide only, 1 medium, 2 medium close-up, 3 close-up). An object insert (closeness 4) offers only units whose region is 'hand'. functionalCategories annotate signature entries (they are not rendered on their own).

functionalCategories.name: Manipulator
functionalCategories.definition: An action in which one part of the body manipulates another body part (self manipulator) or an object (object manipulator) for some type of body contact or care (BAP manual, track Action_function.Manipulator, paraphrased).

functionalCategories.name: Illustrator
functionalCategories.definition: A conversational action that supports accompanying speech by illustrating its rhythm or content (BAP manual, paraphrased).

functionalCategories.name: Emblem
functionalCategories.definition: A conventionalized body action with a culturally fixed form-meaning relationship (BAP manual, paraphrased).

functionalCategories.name: Beat
functionalCategories.definition: A repetitive flicking or striking movement accentuating points in time (subtype of illustrator; BAP manual, paraphrased).

functionalCategories.name: Deictic
functionalCategories.definition: A referential movement indicating an object, person, event or location in space (subtype of illustrator; BAP manual, paraphrased).
